BrainWatch
Lambda-architecture big-data platform for real-time EEG anomaly detection with EHR enrichment.
IT4043E · HUST SOICT · Spring 2026 · Team: Quang-Hung, Kim-Hung, Kim-Quan, Dat, Trang · github.com/pqhhust/Big-Data-Project

### Problem
Hospital-scale neuro-ICU EEG streams (~70 MB / hour / patient) combined with asynchronous EHR updates (vitals, labs, meds) — a nurse can't watch 50 EEG streams in real time.

### Why big data
| V | BrainWatch |
|---|---|
| Volume | 4 TB / month / 50-bed unit |
| Velocity | continuous 10 s windowed chunks |
| Variety | EDF binaries + JSON EHR |
| Veracity | dedup, versioned encounters, late data |
| Value | clinician-actionable alerts |

### In scope
- End-to-end Lambda pipeline (ingest → bronze → silver → gold + streaming alerts)
- Real-time anomaly scoring (`compute_anomaly_score` + `classify_v2`)
- Kubernetes deployment on **EKS** with Cassandra + Kafka KRaft
- Synthetic-at-scale demo (≥ 8 GiB bronze)

### Out of scope
Federated learning · deep-learning scoring · GPU EEG decoding · clinician-facing UI (we ship Matplotlib + Grafana).

│       ehr.updates, alerts.anomaly) │    │   │                     │       │    │                          │
└────────────────────────────────────┘    │  BATCH (CronJob)   SPEED LAYER  │    │   Grafana ◄── this view  │

                                          │                                  │    │                          │
                                          │  ▸ Silver EEG (dedup, quality)   │    └──────────────────────────┘
                                          │  ▸ Silver EHR (row_number latest)│
                                          │  ▸ Patient dim (broadcast)       │

| Capstone-rubric requirement | Where in the code |
|---|---|
| **Window functions** | `silver_layer.build_ehr_silver` — `row_number() over partitionBy(patient_id, encounter_id) orderBy version desc` |
| **Pivot-style indicators** | `gold_layer.build_patient_features` — `max(when(event_type='critical_lab',1).otherwise(0))` |
| **Custom UDFs** | `speed_layer` — `F.udf(compute_anomaly_score)` blends 4 feature terms into a 0–1 score |
| **Broadcast join (unbalanced)** | `gold_layer` — `F.broadcast(patient_dim)`, asserted by `test_patient_dim_join_uses_broadcast` |
| **Sort-merge join (large)** | `gold_layer` — EEG ⋈ EHR on `patient_id` + ±30 min predicate |
| **Partition pruning** | `silver/eeg/site_id=*/ingestion_date=*` parquet partitions |
| **Caching / persistence** | `spark.sql.autoBroadcastJoinThreshold = 50 MiB` set in the batch driver |
| **Structured streaming** | `bronze_ingest` (Kafka source, append mode) + `speed_layer` (Parquet stream, update mode) |
| **Watermarking / late-data** | `eeg_df.withWatermark('event_time','10 minutes')`, EHR 30 min |
| **Exactly-once** | Cassandra `PRIMARY KEY (patient_id, alert_time)` + Spark checkpoint PVC |

| Layer | Choice | Version | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Messaging | Apache **Kafka** | 3.9 KRaft | partition by patient_id, no ZK dependency |
| Stream + Batch | Apache **Spark** | 3.5.5 | one engine for both Lambda halves |
| Serving | **Cassandra** | 4.1 | wide-row time-series with `CLUSTERING ORDER BY alert_time DESC` |
| Orchestration | **Kubernetes** | EKS 1.30 | course requirement; 2× t3.xlarge nodes |
| Storage | EBS **gp3** | — | 5 PVCs (bronze 20 / silver 20 / gold 10 / checkpoints 5 / cassandra 20 GiB) |
| Visualization | **Grafana 11** + Infinity datasource | — | this dashboard |
| Code distribution | **S3** | — | wheel + scripts/, no Docker build |
| Tests | **pytest 9** | — | 67/67 passing |
| Lang | **Python 3.10+** + Scala (Spark JARs) | — | type-hinted, slots dataclasses |

### Cost on EKS
~$0.44/h while cluster runs. Snapshot + tear-down: ~$1/week storage. See repo `infra/cloud/deploy_cloud.sh`.

### Lesson 1 · Bronze AND silver dedup
**Why both?** Bronze guards against Kafka at-least-once redelivery via SHA-256 fingerprint on `(patient_id, session_id, event_time)`. Silver guards against EHR encounter *mutations* via `row_number().over(partition by patient_id, encounter_id order by version desc)`. Same name, different failure modes. Removing either layer reintroduces double-counted alerts in production.

### Lesson 2 · Pin Spark join plans with assertions
`test_patient_dim_join_uses_broadcast` parses `queryExecution.toString()` and asserts `BroadcastHashJoin` appears in the plan. Without it, Catalyst silently falls back to SortMergeJoin (3.4× slower on our fixtures) and CI stays green. The test catches the regression *before* the slow run hits production.

### Lesson 3 · Banish `pass` test bodies
We started the finalize sprint with 67 tests "passing" — but 8 of them were `pass` stubs that asserted nothing, including the silver and gold layer tests. The silver/gold *implementations* were also `pass`. Rewriting both with real fixtures (`tmp_path` + `local[2]` SparkSession + exact-value assertions) closed an entire false-confidence layer.

*Full 11-lesson rubric in `docs/final-report.md` § 11.*
